Game Overview

Noob vs Stickman Zombies is a pixel title where defend your peaceful cabin from relentless stickman zombies as Noob, in an action-packed, arcade adventure. Master the art of archery with precise aiming to fend off stronger foes. Strategize with innovative puzzle elements while enjoying the nostalgic allure of pixel art graphics, ensuring endless thrilling gameplay.
